endorsements.name: Arko Dhar
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-3001
endorsements.description: This vulnerability exists in Milesight Video Management Systems (VMS), all firmware versions prior to 40.7.0.79-r1, due to improper input handling at camera’s web-based management interface. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a specially crafted http request on the targeted network camera. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to cause a Denial of Service condition on the targeted device.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.5)

endorsements.label: CVE-2023-0773
endorsements.description:
The vulnerability exists in Uniview IP Camera due to identification and authentication failure at its web-based management interface. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted HTTP requests to the vulnerable device.

Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow the attacker to gain complete control of the targeted device.

endorsements.name: Arko Dhar
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-30466
endorsements.description:
This vulnerability exists in Milesight 4K/H.265 Series NVR models (MS-Nxxxx-xxG, MS-Nxxxx-xxE, MS-Nxxxx-xxT, MS-Nxxxx-xxH and MS-Nxxxx-xxC), due to a weak password reset mechanism at the Milesight NVR web-based management interface. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow remote attacker to account takeover on the targeted device.
